description: This file defines the GroupRepositoryWrapper class, which provides an abstraction over the GroupRepository to add null checks, error handling, and additional convenience methods for managing Group entities within the application.

classes.name: GroupRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that wraps the GroupRepository providing null checks, error detection, and additional methods for managing Group entities.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a Group by ID, throwing a GroupNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: findByOfficeWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a Group by ID and verifies it is associated with the specified Office; throws exception if not found or mismatch.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Persists a Group entity and immediately flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes pending changes to the database.

methods.name: retrieveSubmittedOndate
methods.description: Retrieves the submission date of the Group type for a given Group ID.
